tools.description: ExifTool with -k option to keep console window open on Windows
tools.usage: \"exiftool(-k).exe\" image.jpg # View metadata with persistent window\n\"exiftool(-k).exe\" -all= clean_image.jpg # Remove all metadata

tools.description: Comprehensive metadata reader/writer for images, videos, and documents
tools.usage:
exiftool image.jpg # Read all metadata
exiftool -GPS* photo.jpg # Show GPS data
exiftool -overwrite_original -all= secure.jpg # Strip metadata
exiftool -r -ext jpg -GPSLatitude . # Find geotagged images
